name: Alan Scott Enterprises Limited
about:
Alan Scott Enterprises Limited, together with its subsidiaries, manufactures and distributes various health and hygiene products in India. It also provides clean air and water solutions; industrial automation and robotics; wellness-led consumer tech; identity and trust platform for the informal and semi-formal workforce; education, AI, and EdTech solutions; R and D, IP, and deep tech; and AI solutions. The company also offers farm-to-home superfoods and clean beauty products; and operates retail stores under Miniso brand name. The company was formerly known as Alan Scott Industries Limited and changed its name to Alan Scott Enterprises Limited in October 2023. Alan Scott Enterprises Limited was incorporated in 1994 and is based in Mumbai, India.
